SHOP buy of 2 Midwest sites for ~$98M
Signals capital deployment into needs-based senior housing, potentially lifting NOI if stabilized.
Higher-acuity mix can support rent and margin resilience through cycles.
9 more sites across FL, OR, IL, IA
Geographic spread reduces concentration risk and broadens demand drivers.
Scale expansion can enhance operating leverage with existing partners.
Operational continuity may speed integration and stabilize occupancy.

This extends NHP’s ongoing portfolio growth in needs-based senior housing, reinforcing a scale-up trend. A clearer view on cap rates, yields, occupancy ramp, and financing terms would determine earnings impact and whether this becomes a stronger catalyst.
